message.lanternring.forge_needs_battery: The forge needs a Power Battery nearby
mode.lanternring.blast.desc: Hold to charge a spinning drill that bores up to 50 blocks; left-click while holding for 5x5 or 7x7
mode.lanternring.wall.desc: Flat 9x9 wall of glowing bricks in front of you for 30 seconds
mode.lanternring.bridge.desc: 3-wide hard-light bridge ahead at your feet (10s)
mode.lanternring.tether.desc: Hold right-click: bubble a mob on a string. Swing and let go to throw, hold left-click to push it out, space stops the reel. Before that, hold left-click and sweep over mobs to pick them (0.5% each) for one free-to-hold bubble
tooltip.lanternring.recharge: Recharge it at a Power Battery, or hold left + right click with one in your off hand
message.lanternring.no_charge: Not enough charge. Recharge at a Power Battery.
message.lanternring.no_ring: You aren't carrying a power ring.
message.lanternring.depleted: Your ring is out of power!
message.lanternring.oath.1: Through darkest night and brightest sun,
message.lanternring.oath.2: my will holds fast till the fight is done.
message.lanternring.oath.3: Let fear itself now turn and flee:
message.lanternring.oath.4: this emerald light burns on through me!
mode.lanternring.anvil.desc: Hold right-click to aim the glowing marker, let go to drop a giant hard-light anvil that smashes a crater. Left-click while aiming to change its level: anvil, drill tank, anchor or ship
mode.lanternring.shield.desc: Hold right-click: a body-high hard-light riot shield in front of you that bounces arrows, tridents, fireballs and shulker bullets back at whoever shot them. Cheaper than the Dome and breaks nothing
mode.lanternring.dome.desc: Hold right-click: clear curved shield that tunnels through anything but bedrock. Run with it; crouch to push it wider
lab.lanternring.hint: Click a setting to try the next version, then rate it
lab.lanternring.lantern_model.classic: Classic Power Battery (green metal, lens port)
lab.lanternring.lantern_model.stone: Stone (ancient battery, light through the cracks)
lab.lanternring.lantern_model.dark: Dark Lantern (twisted jade plates, ring port)
lab.lanternring.charge_style.hand: Left hand (raise the lantern to the ring)
lab.lanternring.charge_style.shrine: Shrine (set it down, kneel, say the oath)
lab.lanternring.copied: Report copied. Paste it to Claude.
inbox.lanternring.placeholder: What should Claude redo, keep or remove? (optional)
tuning.lanternring.hint: Seconds. Type a value or use - and +. Changed values are green.
tuning.lanternring.footer: Applies in singleplayer. Servers read config/lanternring-tuning.json
tuning.lanternring.charge_hold: Lantern: hold left + right click to start charging
tuning.lanternring.lantern_double_click: Lantern: double-click gap to set down
mode.lanternring.deluge.desc: Hold right-click to aim the glowing ring, let go and a hard-light ball forms over it: its bottom crashes down and bursts as the top vanishes into a flood of green liquid and rolls out tsunami waves. Left-click while aiming for a bigger, stronger level. Hold left-click (not aiming) to suck it back into the ring
message.lanternring.deluge_level: Deluge level %s: %s blocks across (%s%% charge each)
tuning.lanternring.flame_ring_melt: Flame Ring melts a mob in
mode.lanternring.inferno.desc: A ring of burning red liquid and fire races 14 blocks out from you. Every mob it reaches dies, melting down into a pool of it. Spares you, your pets and creative players
tuning.lanternring.lava_melt: Lava Deluge melts a layer every
mode.lanternring.portal.desc: Hold right-click to set the exit where you look (aim at a chest to store Loot Golem loot there). Tap to open a portal to it for 15s: walk in one, out the other, even across dimensions
mode.lanternring.golem.desc: A hard-light copper golem that picks up drops around you and carries them through a portal into the chest by your Portal exit. Use again to send it home
message.lanternring.portal_exit_chest: Portal exit set by a chest: the Loot Golem stores loot here
message.lanternring.portal_too_close: Too close to the exit portal
message.lanternring.golem_out: Loot Golem out: it stores drops in the chest by your Portal exit
message.lanternring.golem_no_chest: Loot Golem out. Set a Portal exit by a chest so it can store what it picks up
message.lanternring.golem_full: Loot Golem is full. Set a Portal exit by a chest so it can store its loot
message.lanternring.golem_stored_full: Loot Golem stored %s items; the chest is full, the rest is by the exit
tooltip.lanternring.portal_no_exit: No Portal exit yet: hold right-click in Portal mode to set one
tuning.lanternring.portal_set: Portal: hold to set the exit
mode.lanternring.black_hole.desc: Hold right-click to aim, let go to open a gravity well that pulls in mobs, items and loose blocks, crushes them, then collapses. Left-click while aiming to change its size
tuning.lanternring.build_grow: Build area grows to full size in
tuning.lanternring.build_preview: Build design rises in green in
mode.lanternring.build.desc: Hold right-click to size a glowing area (crouch shrinks it), left-click while holding for circle, square or paint your own. Let go to clear and flatten it, then left-click through builds that fit and right-click to build one
message.lanternring.build_size: %s %s (builds cost %s%% to 75%% charge) - let go to clear it, left-click: shape
message.lanternring.build_none: Nothing fits that area yet. Try a bigger one.
message.lanternring.build_help: %s builds fit, best first. Scroll or left-click: next build (crouch + left-click: back). Crouch + scroll: materials. Right-click: build it. Crouch + right-click: cancel.
message.lanternring.build_one_material: This build comes in one material only.
message.lanternring.build_no_charge: This build needs %s%% charge. Pick a smaller one or recharge at a Power Battery.
mode.lanternring.army.desc: Hold right-click to aim, let go to summon a hard-light ally that only fights hostile mobs. Left-click while holding: Warden, Dragon or Sentry. Crouch as you let go to give it all your charge
tooltip.lanternring.recharge.red: Recharge it at a Red Lantern, or hold left + right click with one in your off hand
message.lanternring.oath.red.1: From smouldering heart to burning skin,
message.lanternring.oath.red.2: the fire I hold is rage within.
message.lanternring.oath.red.3: Let every wrong be paid in flame:
message.lanternring.oath.red.4: this crimson light will speak my claim!
mode.lanternring.lava_deluge.desc: Hold right-click to aim, let go to drop a globe of red burning liquid. It bursts into fire, floods out and sets everything alight, then sinks into the ground and leaves a scorched pit. Left-click while aiming for a bigger level. Hold left-click (not aiming) to suck it back into the ring
tooltip.lanternring.recharge.violet: Recharge it at a Violet Lantern, or hold left + right click with one in your off hand
message.lanternring.oath.violet.1: Through lonely night and bitter part,
message.lanternring.oath.violet.2: I carry light from a loving heart.
message.lanternring.oath.violet.3: All who stand near are bound to me:
message.lanternring.oath.violet.4: this violet star will set them free!
mode.lanternring.mind_link.desc: Links every mob within 16 blocks to you with a violet thread for 5 minutes. They get glowing violet hard-light armour and a blade or bow and fight for you: aim at a creature as you link to send them all after it, otherwise they go for whatever hurts you or whatever you hit. They never touch you, your Hope Golems, Army constructs or pets. Costs 2% per mob linked
message.lanternring.mind_link: Mind Link: %s mobs fight for you
tooltip.lanternring.recharge.orange: Recharge it at an Orange Lantern, or hold left + right click with one in your off hand. Hoarding loot feeds it too
message.lanternring.oath.orange.3: No hoard is ever big enough;
message.lanternring.oath.orange.4: the orange light takes all it can find!
mode.lanternring.hoard.desc: Pulls every item and XP orb within 20 blocks to you. Each stack it hauls in feeds 0.5% back into the ring
mode.lanternring.steal.desc: Snatches what the mob you look at holds or wears (weapon first, then armour). A mob with nothing on is robbed of the loot it would drop, once
mode.lanternring.avarice.desc: Calls up orange copies of the last 3 kinds of mob you killed wearing this ring. They fight for you, drop nothing and fade after a minute
message.lanternring.steal_no_target: Look at a mob to steal from
message.lanternring.avarice_empty: Your hoard of the slain is empty: kill mobs while wearing this ring
tooltip.lanternring.recharge.blue: Recharge it at a Blue Lantern, or hold left + right click with one in your off hand
message.lanternring.oath.blue.1: When every light has left the sky
message.lanternring.oath.blue.2: and all that lives is due to die,
message.lanternring.oath.blue.3: my blue flame grows, and lights the way:
message.lanternring.oath.blue.4: the night will end, there comes a day!
mode.lanternring.renew.desc: A wave of blue light heals you and every friendly creature within 12 blocks, and regrows the land: grass on bare dirt, flowers, ripe crops, grown saplings and living coral
mode.lanternring.restore.desc: Brings back the last villager or tamed pet that died near you, or your own pet wherever it died in this world
mode.lanternring.spark.desc: Blue builder villagers appear where you aim and build a house. While they're still blue, their village grows another house now and then. They fade to normal colours over time
mode.lanternring.hope_golem.desc: Summons a powerful blue iron golem that guards the area for a while
message.lanternring.restore_none: No one has died nearby to bring back
message.lanternring.spark_aim: Aim at the ground where the house should go
message.lanternring.spark_full: There's no room left for another house here
message.lanternring.spark_new: Builders arrive to start a new village
message.lanternring.spark_join: Builders arrive to add a house to the village
message.lanternring.corps_oath: A villager takes the oath and puts on the %s.
message.lanternring.red_oath: A pillager seizes a Red Power Ring and rises into the sky.
message.lanternring.corps_rising: The village's %s bearer rises into the sky to build a floating village.
message.lanternring.corps_floating: A floating village of the %s stands in the sky.
message.lanternring.red_rivals: The Red Lantern Corps has seen the %s village. Raiders are coming to build an outpost in the sky.
message.lanternring.red_outpost: A Red Lantern sky outpost rises over the land.
message.lanternring.red_raid: Red Lantern raiders are attacking the village!
tuning.lanternring.blue_lasso_swing: Blue villagers: lasso swing before the fling
power.lanternring.soul_revive.desc: Brings back mobs that died near you lately, as souls that fight for you
power.lanternring.time_rewind.desc: Turns the blocks around you back to how they were a little while ago
power.lanternring.time_freeze.desc: Stops mobs, arrows, TNT and falling blocks around you dead
tooltip.lanternring.stone_socket: Right-click the Infinity Gauntlet with this in your other hand to set it in
tooltip.lanternring.gauntlet_empty: No stones yet. Right-click with an Infinity Stone in your other hand to set one in
tooltip.lanternring.gauntlet_help: Right-click uses it, crouch + right-click picks the next power
message.lanternring.gauntlet_socket: The %s is set into the Gauntlet
message.lanternring.gauntlet_empty: The Gauntlet has no stones yet
message.lanternring.soul_none: No souls nearby to bring back
message.lanternring.soul_revived: %s souls return to fight for you
message.lanternring.time_freeze: Time stops for %s things around you
tooltip.lanternring.recharge.yellow: Recharge it at a Yellow Lantern, or hold left + right click with one in your off hand
message.lanternring.oath.yellow.1: Let shadows creep and courage fail,
message.lanternring.oath.yellow.2: let every heart grow cold and pale.
message.lanternring.oath.yellow.3: What waits in dark now hunts for you:
message.lanternring.oath.yellow.4: this golden light makes fear come true!
mode.lanternring.fear.desc: Strikes terror into what you aim at and everything near it: darkness closes in round them, they're weakened and slowed and run from you. Use it again on a feared mob to loose the Brood: a giant spider and its spiderlings rush out of the dark at it (12% more)
message.lanternring.feared: %s is afraid. Use Fear on it again to loose the Brood
message.lanternring.feared_many: %s mobs are afraid. Use Fear on one again to loose the Brood
message.lanternring.brood: The Brood comes out of the dark
power.lanternring.soul_graves.desc: Undead claw their way up out of the ground around you and fight for you
message.lanternring.graves_none: No ground here for the dead to rise from
message.lanternring.graves: %s of the dead rise to fight for you
tuning.lanternring.soul_graves_rise: Soul Stone: the dead take this long to rise
tooltip.lanternring.soul_sight: While held, players and mobs show as orange silhouettes through walls
tuning.lanternring.city_piece: Blue sky city: one piece forms in
tuning.lanternring.city_set: Blue sky city: hard light sets into stone after
mode.lanternring.crystal_prison.desc: Seals the creature you aim at in a shell of violet crystal and holds it there for 20 s. Use it on a prisoner again to shatter the crystal early. Costs 5%
message.lanternring.crystal_prison_none: Aim at a creature to imprison it
message.lanternring.crystal_prison_big: Too big for a Crystal Prison
message.lanternring.highway_start: The Blue Lanterns begin raising a highway for fliers between their districts...
message.lanternring.highway_done: The flier highway is complete, and armored diving hawks have come to roost on it.
